description: Twill: a JS/TS syntax-sugar language with trailing closures, guards, block-scoped defer, build plugins, type checking, and editor support.
name: twill-workspace

scripts.check: pnpm verify:release && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:examples && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:package && pnpm --filter @swiftuijs/twill test:size && pnpm editor:package
scripts.editor:build: pnpm --filter twill... run build && pnpm --filter twill verify
scripts.package:tooling: pnpm --filter @swiftuijs/twill-formatter pack --out swiftuijs-twill-formatter-%v.tgz && pnpm --filter @swiftuijs/twill-linter pack --out swiftuijs-twill-linter-%v.tgz && pnpm --filter @swiftuijs/twill-migrate pack --out swiftuijs-twill-migrate-%v.tgz
scripts.test:tooling: pnpm package:core && pnpm package:tooling && pnpm --filter @swiftuijs/twill-formatter --filter @swiftuijs/twill-linter --filter @swiftuijs/twill-migrate run test:package
scripts.test:packed: node packages/twill/tests/consumer.mjs --packed && node packages/formatter/tests/consumer.mjs && node packages/linter/tests/consumer.mjs && node packages/migrate/tests/consumer.mjs
scripts.deps:check: pnpm audit --audit-level moderate && pnpm peers check
